title: Research 9/9 (Part III, RESEARCH ONLY - ZERO CODE): mechanism-design survey - which precedent primitives markets presuppose
description: Roadmap Part III research mandate (docs/civilizational-roadmap-brief.md:73) under coordinator decision D8: Part III produces EXACTLY ONE research artifact and NO code; Part IV is untouched; the sequence is load-bearing (Part V principle 2, line 93). Survey mechanism-design basics (auction formats and incentive compatibility, budget balance, the revelation principle at a survey level, escrow and bonding, reputation as credit, principal-agent and moral hazard, and Hayek's knowledge problem as the motivation) and identify which precedent-layer primitives the future market layer presupposes: property and ownership, contract, enforcement, dispute resolution, identity, and an auditable ledger. Purpose: build Step One market-ready without building Step Two. Output docs/precedent-research/09-mechanism-design-market-primitives.md. Web research for the mechanism-design canon PLUS the corpus sources already located by the librarian; tagged claims; mandatory implications section.
acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY ONE FILE (create only this; touch no other file): docs/precedent-research/09-mechanism-design-market-primitives.md. Create the parent directory with mkdir -p (idempotent and race-safe: the nine research tasks run in parallel, share no file, and no bootstrap root serializes them). Do NOT create or edit docs/precedent-research/README.md - that index is owned solely by the epic join T-348 (F1 single-owner rule).

WEB RESEARCH IS REQUIRED (coordinator decision D7): at least 5 named sources, of which at least 3 are primary (a judgment with its case name and citation, a statute or code article, an official practice statement or court rule, or a named-author treatise / peer-reviewed article). Every source is listed in a final Sources section with a retrievable identifier (case name plus citation, or URL plus retrieval date). Parametric-only claims with no locatable source are tagged SPECULATION, never ESTABLISHED.

EVERY substantive claim carries exactly one tag: ESTABLISHED (attributable to a named source in the Sources section), ANALOGY (a mapping from legal doctrine onto agent mechanics - the mapping is this agent's inference, not the source's claim), or SPECULATION (neither). An untagged substantive claim is a defect and grounds for REJECT. Basis: roadmap Part V principle 5, no fabricated rigor (docs/civilizational-roadmap-brief.md:96).

MANDATORY SECTION titled exactly 'Implications for the agent harness': map each finding onto the real substrate by name - blackboard task IDs (T-xxx), the three roles (thinker, worker, verifier) plus coordinator, and the four authority tiers of coordinator decision D4 (1 operator, 2 constitutional, 3 verdicted, 4 single-agent). For each finding state which schema field, CLI subcommand, or protocol rule it demands, or state explicitly that it demands none.

MANDATORY SECTION titled exactly 'Extends, does not duplicate': for every doctrine that already has a partial implementation in this repo, cite it by file:line and say whether the finding EXTENDS the existing record or would DUPLICATE it. The candidates the scout already located: note taxonomy DECISION/DEVIATION/TRADEOFF/OPEN-QUESTION (ORCHESTRATION.md:69-77), the reopen verb with its mandatory-reasoning gate (.harness/bin/blackboard.py:470-517, ORCHESTRATION.md:58-67), the P-number ledger (state.json evolution.accepted_mutations), prose P-number citations in ORCHESTRATION.md, recontext.py append-only cited-evidence log, events.jsonl semantic event floor. MANDATORY: state at least one finding that CUTS AGAINST the roadmap brief or the coordinator decision memo where the sources support one. If the sources support none, say so explicitly and say why - a document with zero friction against its own commissioning brief is treated as unverified cheerleading.
NO CODE and NO edits under .harness/ or to PRECEDENT.md. Research tasks have no build dependencies and must create none.

Verification tier: DOC TIER per P-024 (proportional verification) - the verifier does a BRIEF replay (file exists at the exact path; every substantive claim tagged; Sources section present with the required counts; the two mandatory sections present; spot-check that 2 named sources exist), NOT a full adversarial replay. Hand off with blackboard.py handoff --to-role verifier (never self-mark done). The handoff note must name the 3 findings that most change the schema, each with the tag it carries.

HARD SCOPE BOUNDARY: research only. No code, no schema for budgets or bids, no CLI, no task proposals that build the market layer. Violating this violates coordinator decision D8 and roadmap Part V principle 2. This task has NO downstream build dependency - its only edge is to the epic join T-348.

MUST ground the institutional-primitives half in the corpus sources the librarian already verified by file and page, and cite them as such rather than re-deriving them: contract-first decomposition contingent on verifiability (papers/intelligent_ai_delegation.pdf:9), bidirectional smart contracts with formal verification and automated penalties (:10), re-auction with the defaulter covering the price difference (:14), reputation as public verifiable history versus trust as a private threshold (:16, and Table 3 at :17), the arbitration clause plus escrow bond and the optimistic challenge window with human or agent adjudication panels (:20), liability firebreaks and immutable provenance (:23), market-design requirements for reputation-gated access, immutable activity ledgers and cryptographic identity (papers/distributional_agi_safety.pdf:7) and hash-chained append-only decision logs (:8), and the jurisprudential framing of agent-collective liability drawing on group agency and corporate liability (papers/virtual_agent_economies.pdf approximately pp.18-22).

MUST use the corpus's cleanest demonstration of the gap: coffee-bench-reference/coffeebench/environment.py:118-122 (late-payment interest) and :359-374 ('ONCE BANKRUPT, ALWAYS BANKRUPT') implement contracts and automatic enforcement, while grep finds NO occurrence of 'dispute' in environment.py or marketplace.py - contracts and enforcement without adjudication. State what that predicts about a market layer built on this harness before the precedent layer exists.

MUST DELIVER a checklist: each primitive the market layer presupposes, mapped either to a specific field or subcommand the v0 precedent layer should ship (so Step One is market-ready) or to an explicit 'NOT covered by v0, deferred, and here is the cost of deferring'. This checklist is what the epic join presents as the Part III deliverable.

MUST state which primitives the precedent layer CANNOT supply no matter how it is designed (for example: metering and budget accounting, cryptographic identity), so the market-layer epic starts with an honest boundary.
